title: CBL source to Libya Herald: CBL moving towards ending cash collection of taxes and customs duties
why: POS terminals for Tax and Customs Authorities; electronic payment in service, cash being phased out.

title: Dbeibah issues a decision to collect public revenues electronically
why: Decree 60 of 2026 obliges treasuries to accept electronic payment of taxes, customs duties and fees.

title: مصلحة الضرائب تعلن بدء العمل الرسمي بالمنظومة الضريبية الموحدة
why: Tax Authority unified tax system and digital platforms; e-payment of taxes.

title: National Unity Ministry of Finance Requires Customs and Tax Authorities Not to Collect Amounts Exceeding 500 Dinars Except via Certified Checks or Electronic Payment
why: Tax and customs amounts over 500 dinars must be paid by check or electronically.

title: New decision introduces electronic tax collection system
why: Decision 448 of 2025 on income tax payment by transfer and card.

title: Customs Authority to Launch Full ASYCUDA System Next Month
why: Customs electronic declaration system full launch; coverage of customs duties.

title: Libya: Technical Assistance Report-Redesign of Income Tax Forms; IMF Technical Assistance Report No. 24/100
why: States income tax administration is paper-based with no enterprise computer systems.

title: Taxes can now be paid through e-payments: Finance Ministry
why: Decision 247 of 2024 approves electronic collection of income tax; infrastructure to be prepared.
